comment: The table of the fort checker and the rules of D3.14 for the pointer places of a cast. At the
first level that the result of a cast marks `mut`, a cast keeps each pointer place of the source
with its exact type. At level 1 of each view, it keeps each pointer place that carries a mark
with its exact type, and each place with no mark with its type or a type that differs only by
the marks that it drops. A function pointer carries a mark, and a cast from a `void*` to a
function pointer type is an error. No cast makes a pointer from an integer, and no cast makes
the pointee of a typed pointer larger or more aligned. An argument of an `extern fn` follows
each rule, and the walks of the places have a work limit. The rows cover src/fort/check.ft and
src/fort/types.ft. In check.ft: check_cast, check_pointee_growth, check_pointer_places,
check_view_places, report_function_pointer, carries_mark, mark_step, walk_marks, close_set,
enter_struct, first_hidden and part_at. In types.ft: type_cast_allowed, type_cast_makes_pointer,
type_is_pointer_place, the pointer count of type_layout_struct and the mark of a layout. Each
row breaks one of these rules. The stages are the cast corpus of test/lang, whose fail tests pin
the message, the byte and the level of each place, and the checker suite, which pins the count
and the position of each report. The table runs in the VM: pass a --runner that runs tools/vm
run in one slot and then syncs, as notes/environment.md says. The md5 guard reads the product
compiler that the build links. Put a row that an earlier run caught first, because the first
round of a run in the VM can read stale (notes/testing.md). The checker suite runs with
--timeout 120: the rows D3.14-keep-memo and D3.14-keep-modulo change the time of the walk and
not its answer, and the shapes of 128 to the power 6 owners in check_expr_test.ft then pass the
timeout. The checker suite holds check_mark_limit_test.ft, the one witness of D3.14-mark-count:
its chain of 65600 structs takes about 13 s in the VM.
build: sleep 2 && touch src/fort/check.ft src/fort/types.ft && ninja -C build/Linux/debug fort

stages.name: the cast corpus
stages.command: python3 test/lang/run_tests.py --fort build/Linux/debug/fort --std-dir build/Linux/debug/std -j 4 fail/casts/ run/casts/

stages.name: the checker suite
stages.command: python3 test/lang/run_tests.py --root test/fort --fort build/Linux/debug/fort --std-dir build/Linux/debug/std --timeout 120 -j 4 check_expr_test session_test check_mark_limit_test
